verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents private status pages restricted by password protection, and its status-page marketing lists SSO, password, and IP protection. Together these cover the core of employee-only or restricted-audience pages. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of customer-specific audience segmentation (e.g., per-customer pages or granular viewer permissions), in-depth docs on how SSO and IP restriction are configured, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
